cuda_tensors_recursively: recursively move PyTorch tensors and modules to a specified CUDA device
cuda_dict_of_tensors: move a dictionary of PyTorch tensors to the GPU using recursive cuda
cuda_list_of_tensors: move a list of PyTorch tensors to the GPU using recursive cuda
cuda_model_and_state: move a model and its state dict to GPU with a single recursive call
cuda_nested_structures: recursively apply cuda to nested dicts and lists containing tensors
